name: HIPAA retention, access rights and deletion
description: HIPAA retention, access rights and deletion. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

controls.title: HIPAA documentation and accounting records are kept six years
controls.requirement: HIPAA documentation and accounting records are kept six years; the vault enforces the floor.

controls.title: Medical record retention follows the longest applicable period
controls.requirement: Medical record retention follows the longest applicable period; earlier deletion is refused.

controls.title: Prompts
controls.requirement: Prompts, completions and traces with PHI inherit their record class's retention, and no longer.

controls.title: Access requests are timed (30 days plus one extension) and fulfilled from the record of tr
controls.requirement: Access requests are timed (30 days plus one extension) and fulfilled from the record of truth.

controls.title: Erasure is coordinated with legal hold and retention so required records survive
controls.requirement: Erasure is coordinated with legal hold and retention so required records survive.
